newsitem.title: USA: Seven Chicago cops accused of being robbers.
newsitem.headline: Seven Chicago cops accused of being robbers.

text.p: Seven Chicago policemen were arrested on Friday in what officials said was a conspiracy to rob and extort money from undercover agents posing as drug dealers.
The seven, all of whom worked in the same district on the city's West Side, were named in a federal indictment along with an eighth man who was not a police employee.
"The indictment alleges that these defendants were cops and robbers," U.S. Attorney James Burns said.
"They violated their sworn oaths to uphold the law and brazenly went on the offensive. Instead of protecting and serving the public, they sought only to serve themselves," he added.

The seven tactical officers who were arrested on Friday before the indictment was announced were accused of taking, by robbery and extortion, more than $65,000 from undercover agents posing as drug dealers
In addition to the conspiracy charges the indictment alleged various other offences including firearms violations and attempted robbery.

Police Superintendent Matt Rodriguez said the case stemmed from an internal police investigation which was turned over to the FBI. He said the development was especially tragic because crime in the city has fallen for the last five years.
